description: This file is a shell script implementing a series of automated tests for Git pre-push hook functionality, including setup, failure cases, bypass options, and multiple references handling.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, running the provided commands.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers commands to run after each test, for cleanup.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares actual output with expected output files.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the given command fails.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks that a specific path does not exist.

methods.name: test_git_oid_zero
methods.description: Represents the zero (null) Git object ID.

methods.name: test_hook
methods.description: Helper function to set up and invoke Git hooks for testing.
